4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_rack.lang_desc: wooden shelf with a deer head on it. it is located near a chair, picture frame, blinds, a record player, and a speaker.
wooden rack with a picture of a deer on it. it is located near a picture frame, a carpet, a picture, and a refrigerator.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_washbasin.lang_desc: washbasin, a double sink vanity with a mirror above it. the washbasin is located towards the middle of the room. it can be found near the mirror, which is slightly higher. to the right of the washbasin, you will find a bathroom cabinet. toward the bottom left corner of the washbasin, there is a towel hanging. finally, near the top right corner of the washbasin, there is a cardboard box.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_heater.lang_desc: gas-fired water heater. look for it near the washbasin and laundry machine.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_couch.lang_desc: plaid couch in the room. it is located near a cabinet.
black leather couch in the room. the couch is located near a lamp table. it is also close to a blanket and a pillow. look for the couch within these objects.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_bed.lang_desc: king size bed located near the pillow.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_blanket.lang_desc: blanket that is located on top of the couch. the blanket is tan in color.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_tv.lang_desc: the tv stand located near the entertainment set. on the tv stand, you will find the tv.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_sink cabinet.lang_desc: the sink cabinet, which is a double sink cabinet, located next to the kitchen counter and dishwasher.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_oven and stove.lang_desc: white oven and stove located on the kitchen counter.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_bathroom cabinet.lang_desc: bathroom cabinet. it is located above the washbasin and below the shower curtain.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_towel.lang_desc: blue and white striped towel in the bathroom. it is located near the shower curtain.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_cloth.lang_desc: white cloth located near the dresser and the curtain.

4ok3usBNeis.basis.glb_desk.lang_desc: desk located next to a picture frame, a picture, and a desk lamp.
